critique: The render successfully uses ornate gold holiday-ornament sprites on black, with a broad Form-style field and visible evolving deformation between t1 and t4. However, the particles are substantially overpacked: many bulbs merge into dense, muddy vertical piles, obscuring the individual bulb silhouette and leaving irregular large black voids. The result reads more like clustered ornament debris than a clean, intentionally structured Shape Grids preset. Motion is present, but the rapid rearrangement of the dense clusters makes the grid/form structure hard to perceive.

suggestions.why: Reduce maximum particle size so individual bulbs separate from one another, restoring recognizable ornament silhouettes and a clearer Shape Grids structure.
Lower size randomness to prevent oversized bulbs from dominating and collapsing the field into uneven clumps.
